plan.title: Remediate dynamic eval in app.py
plan.root_cause: Dynamic eval can execute attacker-controlled code. Use explicit parsing and allowed operations.
plan.strategy: Replace dynamic eval with a safe parser that only allows arithmetic operations on numeric values. Ensure that the parser rejects all calls, attributes, names, and nonnumeric constants.
risks: Potential execution of arbitrary code if not properly restricted
Loss of functionality if arithmetic operations are not correctly parsed
plan.expected_result: All arithmetic tests should pass without executing arbitrary code. The build command should complete successfully.

attempts.summary: Replace dynamic eval with a safe parser that only allows arithmetic operations on numeric values.

evidence.diff:
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -1,6 +1,35 @@
 """Explicitly labelled KYRO test fixture. Intentionally vulnerable; never deploy."""
+
+import ast
+import operator
+
+allowed_operators = {
+    ast.Add: operator.add,
+    ast.Sub: operator.sub,
+    ast.Mult: operator.mul,
+    ast.Div: operator.truediv,
+    ast.USub: operator.neg,
+}
 
 
 def calculate(expression: str):
     """Preserve arithmetic behavior while testing remediation of dynamic eval."""
-    return eval(expression)
+    try:
+        node = ast.parse(expression, mode='eval').body
+        return evaluate(node)
+    except (SyntaxError, AttributeError, TypeError) as e:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid expression: {expression}") from e
+
+
+def evaluate(node):
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Num):  # <number>
+        return node.n
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):  # <left> <operator> <right>
+        left = evaluate(node.left)
+        right = evaluate(node.right)
+        return allowed_operators[type(node.op)](left, right)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):  # <operator> <operand> e.g., -1
+        operand = evaluate(node.operand)
+        return allowed_operators[type(node.op)](operand)
+    else:
+        raise TypeError(node)
